title: Directed connected scatterplot
intent: Show the changing relationship between two quantitative measures along one chronological path.

ai.create: Create a connected scatterplot from the raw driving {side, year, miles, gas} observations with a smooth path, one dot per observation, five-year labels, and sampled arrows that make direction clear.
ai.maintain: Change label cadence and arrow sampling while retaining chronological order, responsive quantitative scales, and a single inferred row type.
